note: raw_url points at a branch, not a commit, on purpose: a pinned commit's content never changes, so pinning one would make scripts/check-vectors.mjs incapable of ever noticing drift. The digest is what is pinned. When the upstream PR merges, change raw_url to the flop-labs/technocore-chat main branch and drop pull_request; nothing else here or in the suite depends on the fork.
